authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full markaṭa² spider article gives Prakrit makkaḍa, Punjabi makkaṛ/makṛī, Nepali mākuro, Assamese makarā, Bengali mākaṛ, Oriya makaṛā and Hindi makṛā/makṛī. Selected simple survey spider forms preserve the corresponding makVr/makVḍ stem, with regional vowel quality, stop/flap notation and gender endings retained. Local IA transmission is unresolved. Longer -śa forms, extra morphology and multiword responses are excluded. The separately inspected 9884 markaṭaka article concerns grass and is not the parent. Exact response: makor.
